[LINT.2.3] The result is always half-open. An interval that includes `end` is written
with its `end` one step later: one nanosecond for a `Time` or a `Duration`,
one day for a `Date`, one for an `Int`. A `Float` or `String` interval has no
next value, so it cannot include its `end` ([LINT.1.1]).
